queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__is_attributes ( is_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, storefront_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL default 0, attribute_type char(1) NOT NULL default 'T', object_type char(1) NOT NULL default 'P', PRIMARY KEY (is_id), UNIQUE (storefront_id, attribute_type, object_type) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
